name: Move speed icon
description: Passive icon: a single teal arrowhead aimed right. Port of the hand-drawn i_movespeed from Feelers' BootScene. Tile and glyph are `$spore`. They were `$aqua.light`, which sat ΔE 9.4 from Stink's `$frost`: a pale-blue arrow beside a pale-blue clock. The arrow keeps its cool hue and goes green of it, 23.6 from `$frost` and 25 or more from everything else on the bar.
